The one remaining participant who seroconverted self-reported optimal PrEP usage (daily); this was provided some support through results from hair analysis, described below.
Rationale: The paper mentions that 42 of the 43 participants who seroconverted during the trial reported suboptimal PrEP usage, which likely involved previous exposure to ARV drugs. However, it does not provide specific information on whether these individuals had previously received ARV drugs.
